title: Optimal degree bounds for sum-of-squares representations
summary: The moment-sum-of-squares (SOS) hierarchy provides a sequence of bounds on the minimum of a polynomial over a basic closed semialgebraic set, i.e., a subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$ defined by finitely many polynomial constraints. We establish optimal bounds on the error of the SOS hierarchy in the following settings: 1. If the constraints define an Archimedean quadratic module: the error of the Putinar-based hierarchy at level $k$ is $Θ((\log k)^4/k^2)$ in the worst case. 2.
